harper: opening a follow-up thread for the KV memory leak postmortem. need discrete owners, short checkpoints, and a reproducible test plan.
harper: I created a tracker doc: https://redwood.internal/kv-remediation-tracker — please add your row with ticket link + ETA by EOD Thu.
noah: I'll own the allocation profiling + pprof artifacts. ETA: first full-night run in 48h.
li: i'll take GC config experiments (gc_low, compact_on_idle) and the canary gating rules. aiming for initial canary next Tue.
sre-kim: perf/ops will handle routing fallbacks and emergency circuit (soft-evict -> route-away). i'll prototype the router rule.
ops-bot: recurring-pattern: median lead time from kv_alloc burst to OOM = 7m 40s across clusters (see /monitor/kv-burst-patterns)
harper: noted. owners: noah=profiling, li=gc tuning+canary, sre-kim=routing+circuit. I'll coordinate stakeholder comms and the decision checkpoint.
noah: minimal profiler extract from last run:
noah: ```
# top hot paths
kv_insert: 34.1%
alloc_block: 21.7%
ref_inc: 9.3%
``` 
li: GC experiments i'll try:
li: - gc_low=0.42 -> 0.5 (stepwise)
li: - compact_on_idle=true
li: - aggressive_window=20s for canary
sre-kim: routing sketch:
sre-kim: - soft_limit_pct=80 -> mark shard degraded
sre-kim: - on soft: async compact + route 60% traffic to spare pool
sre-kim: - hard_limit_pct=94 -> refuse new writes + escalate
harper: repro workload idea (small keys churn + intermittent large writes):
harper: ```
for i in range(0, 20000):
  put("k_%d" % i, rand_bytes(256))
  if i % 400 == 0:
    put("big_%d" % i, rand_bytes(800000))
  sleep(3ms)
```
noah: i'll add structured traces + flamegraphs to the tracker bucket and tag them with canary-date.
li: plan for canary: roll to 3 nodes, run synthetic workload for 6h, collect frag_ratio, kv_alloc_rate, p95/p99 latency every 1m. decision after 48h of stable metrics.
sre-kim: i'll implement dashboard panels: frag_ratio trend, soft-evict count, alloc slope, and route-offs. ETA: 3d.
harper: final asks: 1) add ticket links + ETA to tracker doc; 2) owners drop 1-line status in tracker each Mon; 3) tag all artifacts with canary id. Closing thread after tracker rows are updated. :white_check_mark:
filename_note: KV memory leak follow-up: owners, canary plan, and routing circuit
